findings.desc: concept-cleanup: the retired conditional Antigravity/agy proposer is incompletely removed from docs/requirements/decisions/multi-host-keyword-candidate-spec-routing-execution-plan.md. B-137a deleted the agy branch from core/candidate-spec-routing.ts (collectHostKeywordProposals now runs only codex-cli and claude-cli; requestAgy is gone from the args interface, the handler schema, and CandidateSpecRouteArgs), and updated the doc header (line 8-12), section 1 item 3, the non-goals list, section 8.1, the artifact-union note, and the closing acceptance list. Two spots still present the deleted proposer as a live path: line 97 in the section 6 ASCII pipeline diagram still renders 'optional agy proposal' as a stage between the Codex/Claude proposals and the normalized keyword/query union, and line 561 in the edge-case table still carries the row '| `agy` unavailable | primary pair continues; availability recorded |', which describes availability handling for a host that is no longer attempted at all. Per the concept-residue rule that comments and prose mislead future developers, these are residue. Severity is low rather than blocking because the same file's explicit B-137a 'Execution correction' header (lines 8-12) and the rewritten section 8.1 both supersede them, so a reader who starts at the top is not misled about current behavior; no code, schema, or gate consumes these two lines.
